neighbours.label: parenthetical insertions after a comma: 'other' in 'among other things', interjected 'well,', 'it turns out', 'if not'
fire: The festival offers, among other things, free concerts every evening.
She studied, amongst other subjects, Greek and astronomy.
The plan was, it turns out, far more expensive than anyone said.
This tool will help, if not completely solve, the scheduling problem.
I recommend this course for anyone who is, well, curious about stars.
His campaign focused, among other issues, on rural broadband.
The bakery became, it seems, the busiest shop on the street.
The museum holds, among other treasures, a rare medieval map.
quiet: The festival offers free concerts every evening in the square.
She studied Greek and astronomy at a small college.
The plan was far more expensive than anyone said.
This tool will help with the scheduling problem quite a lot.
I recommend this course for anyone who is curious about stars.
His campaign focused on rural broadband and better roads.
The bakery became the busiest shop on the street.
The museum holds a rare medieval map in its main hall.

notes: Card: weak pole, peaks ' other' x7 (amongst other matters, among other things), ' well' (for anyone, well, anyone), ' it' (This is, it turns out), ' if' (benefit from, if not require). Sign regimes leak 38%. Near misses keep the sentences without the interjected phrase.
